body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: f5b1eccd0a873141c9f7b423e423a8eeb7ce567e -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

What looks good

- The tool reads the held shape with `HolderShape::of`, puts the stated fields over it, builds the outline with `HolderShape::kind` and `HolderShape::geometry(ADAPTIVE_PORT)`, and lands the edit as one `EditDocumentComponent` through the History - the same undoable command the holder form's Apply queues (`crates/app/src/mcp/holder_shape_tools.rs`, `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_library_dialog/holder_form.rs`). No new undo command.
- Refusals match the form: a value that cannot describe steel (`holder not changed: <ShapeError>`), an empty name (`the holder needs a name`), an edit that changes nothing (the command's "already so"), and a broken fit (the command's refusal, naming the component and the tool). Each is pinned in `crates/app/tests/tool_library_holders/holder_shape_mcp.rs`.
- No new dependency, no new top-level test binary: the pinning tests join the existing `tool_library_holders` directory suite. No `commands/` change, no snapshot PNG, no `.github/` change.
- Docs: the generated reference row and the guide row name `edit_user_holder` (the `mcp_doc_drift` tests are green on the head).

Results merged with main (trial merge clean; self-hosted runner `main=4d891498e7270eabba1b82809d08228b465c0aec`)

- Runner: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/46069032068 - head `f5b1eccd0` verified by the workflow. Quick gate (merged tree): 169 steps, 0 failed - including `app suites: tool_library_holders` (both pinning tests: ok), `app suites: mcp_doc_drift` (ok), `app suites: example_catalog` (ok), all other smoke suites ok. Clippy step on the runner failed on the environment: `'cargo-clippy' is not installed for the toolchain 'stable-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu'` - re-run locally: `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` exits 0, clean.
- Local: all reads and checks above on the worktree of the head.

Targeted tests

- Example catalog suites (post/toolpath change): none. This diff changes only MCP tool surface and docs; nothing under the catalog or the heavy lanes changed.
- Light lane: green — 6 steps, 0 failed, wall 25.8 min (6 steps: light build release --no-run, motion light: lib, adaptive_troch_island, adaptive_troch_neck, adaptive_troch_parallel, app light: pocket_pass_start). Run locally on the head with sccache; not a safety-floor change.
- No heavy step: not a `P1` PR; no safety-floor change.
- The PR body names the quick gate and `mcp_doc_drift` and `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` as the green steps on the head; the runner confirmed the quick gate and `mcp_doc_drift` green; clippy confirmed clean locally.

Requested before merge

None.

Questions / notes

- The `camcraft-mcp` skill row is deliberately not in this PR (the skill is a process file; #4432 holds the proposed row). That matches the body.
- The `tool_library_holders` suite header's Gate map and module list do not yet name `app::mcp (holder_shape_tools)` - a one-line tidy that can ride the next push, not a blocker.
- `HolderShape::of` reads the held largest diameter back as Ø38.748558 mm on the test holder, not the Ø44 mm that built it. The PR body names this; the outline is the same. A call that changes the nose diameter on a shrink holder should state `largest_d` (documented).
- Stating `bore` on an ER clamp is silently ignored (the ER reads its collet range from its size); the tool echoes the stated value in its JSON. Documented behaviour, not blocked.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Delta review of the merge commit 2f0a4f5 (Merge origin/main into issue/4391-mcp-edit-user-holder). The reviewed head f5b1eccd was superseded by this merge of main; the earlier full review (self-hosted runner quick gate, local clippy, local light lane) stands for the rest of the tree.

The remerge-diff is one hunk in one generated file, docs/agents/mcp-tools.md (the tool-count line, hand-resolved conflict). Verified on the merged tree: the file says "The server lists 138 tools", which matches the 138 unique live tool names in crates/app/src/mcp/*.rs (catalog counts the same 138), and the edit_user_holder row is present with its row text. No logic was merged - the remerge-diff changes no source file, no test, no snapshot PNG, no process file. No rebuild is owed by the delta; the original full review of f5b1eccd covers the PR's own code.

A clean merge of main keeps the review; the delta review is clean. The full review of the pre-merge head stands, and the label applies to this head.
